text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both advancing modestly in line with broader crypto strength, with BTC holding near $87k and ETH above $2,770, signaling stable demand across the two majors. The Fear & Greed index at 71 and climbing 20 points over a week indicates sentiment has swung decisively into greed territory, though the gains remain measured rather than explosive. Bitcoin's 58.8% dominance and $121B daily volume suggest risk appetite is present but not yet frenzied—traders are rotating cautiously rather than chasing.
